exec: // Resolve base URLs based on env
// Helper: build <input> byte array tags from an XML string (UTF-8-ish for ASCII).
// NDML sample implementation in code uses Buffer.from(xml,'utf8') then Array.from(buffer).
// Postman sandbox doesn't expose Node Buffer; we'll do a best-effort UTF-8 for common ASCII payloads.
// For non-ASCII chars, ensure your XML values are ASCII/uppercase as per KRA note.
// If a request sets inner_xml, precompute registration_inputs
// Extract getPasswordReturn and store as encryptedPassword
// Set inner_xml for registration -> converted to <input> tags by collection prerequest script
